title: Fluffy Savory Buns
description: Soft and fluffy savory buns made with kneaded dough and a touch of lightness. Perfect for snacking or serving alongside your favorite meals.
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add kneaded dough and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disks onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each bun.
Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with savory.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the buns are golden brown.
Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
